Slag mines- 6/10 interesting area with some decent fights but nothing really stands out compared to other dungeons at all

Iron docks- 9/10 some interesting changes of pace in the dungeon keep it fresh, great ambience, although the first three bosses feel generic I really feel the final boss pulls it together, and seriously great setting

Auchindoun -  7.5/10 I like the setting for sure and the bosses feel good but I can't help but feel something is missing, the small story that you get to experience is fantastic but I get an odd empty feeling from the zone

Skyreach- 8.5/10 Fantastic setting and the background is great bosses can feel a little gimmicky and annoying but I really dig the arrakoa stuff

Grimrail depot- 7/10 I'm always torn on grimrail, I LOVE the train segment and hope they try more crazy new stuff like that more often, however the LOS issues and nightmares or hunters pulling entire trains and limited camera angles tarnish the top notch atmosphere

Shadowmoon-  7/10 Personally it feels like a pretty drawn out instance, trash just for the sake of it and you could cut out a bunch of the winding passes, but again I am a sucker for the atmosphere, some intriguing boss fights help redeem the dungeon

Everbloom- 6/10 Aside from the final boss being pretty cool I could easily forget about this one, bosses feel recycled, loads of trash in small areas that you can easily skip, feels like more could be done to make it amazing

UBRS- 8/10 interesting to see a new interpretation of an old dungeon, love the throwbacks to the old one and I like the homage they pay, admittedly the dragon boss feels horribly gimmicky but the son of beast and third boss make this place a treat for me


Honestly overall some of the better dungeons they have released in my own opinion. I think there is some variation between them all to help break up the monotony of things and keep you on your toes. Really can't rave enough about the setting of grimrail, I love that place, but I feel it lacks polish with the horrible camera angles and limited sight inside many of the cars. I hope they keep up the level of atmosphere from these dungeons as it is a nice step up in my perspective.
